title: Your Data Is Not Truly Yours

segments.text: Over 500 movies deleted from your online account.
PlayStation reminds us: nothing digital is ever truly ours.
Streaming services retain control over your content.
Even bought movies can vanish without warning.
A stark reminder of our digital ownership limits.
You could lose access anytime, for any reason.
Over 500 movies deleted from your online account.
Follow for daily tech and AI news.
